THIS STEP IS A NET +5 THAT COMBINES TWO OPPOSITE MOVEMENTS, measured separately in an isolated worktree so neither hides the other: mainline at 84b42a90543 measures 2082 against the committed floor of 2069, i.e. the gate was ALREADY RED BY +13 from commits landed between 8fecc196d5e and 84b42a90543 (the ActionSwiper/autocomplete/notebook/emoji_picker/error_dialogs series) whose authors did not re-measure the floor; this commit's own change is worth -8 on top of that, giving 2074. The +13 is absorbed here only because leaving the floor at 2069 keeps CI red for everyone; it is NOT this commit's debt and should be paid down by whoever owns those commits. @TYPES/LUXON IS NOW ADOPTED and is itself count-neutral. The previous revision of this note measured the dependency ALONE at +4 and warned it off; paying the two root causes it exposes cancels that. (1) datetime_picker.js, datetime_field.js and datetime_input.js each carried '@typedef {any} DateTime', an escape hatch for the missing types that silently made every DateTime-annotated value in those files 'any' and, with real types present, collides with the imported DateTime (TS2440). Deleted. (2) '.ts' (epoch ms) is a real runtime field of every luxon DateTime that @types/luxon does not surface; four files read it and two had already resorted to '/** @type {any} */' casts. Now declared once in @types/luxon_default.d.ts. THE AUGMENTATION MUST TARGET 'luxon/src/datetime', the module that DECLARES the class -- augmenting 'luxon', which only re-exports it, creates a second unrelated symbol, merges with nothing, and silently leaves the errors in place. Do not 'simplify' it. toMillis() is not a substitute: it returns NaN on an invalid DateTime. Adoption also surfaced two real defects in datetime_picker.js where 'a?.ts' and 'val?.minute' were applied to NullableDateTime (= DateTime|false|null): optional chaining guards only null/undefined, so the false member reached property access and produced undefined by boxing rather than by intent. Heaviest remaining: addons/web/static/tests/views/{form,list,calendar}_view.test.js and core/network/rpc.test.js. Dominant codes TS2345/TS2339/TS2322.
